runtime/json#

The native layer under json: the calls those modules make into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under json: the calls those modules make into the host runtime. Programs use those modules instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native object JsonParseState#

native object JsonParseState

Private exact JSON parse tree and diagnostics. The public json module wraps these opaque states in immutable Json values.

native json_member_text#

native json_member_text(origin is JsonNodeState, name is string) is string

One member of an object node read in one call: its text, number spelling, boolean, or int when the spelling is a plain integer of up to 18 digits. Any other case (not an object, no such member, another kind, another number) is invalid_input; callers then read the member the long way.

native json_node_write#

native json_node_write(origin is JsonNodeState, indentation is int) is string

JSON text of a node: compact for a negative indentation, otherwise one member or element per line, level * indentation spaces, ": " after names, [] and {} for empty containers and no final line break. A number is written positionally for integers up to 21 digits and fractions down to 1e-6, in the canonical Decimal form beyond them; a string with '"' and '' escaped, \n, \r, \t by name and the other controls U+0000..U+001F as lowercase \u00xx.

native json_node_pointer#

native json_node_pointer(root is JsonNodeState, target is JsonNodeState) is string

The RFC 6901 pointer of target inside root (the same node, found depth first; invalid_input when it is not inside), and the member names and values of an object and the items of an array in order.
